title: Leading of the Holy Spirit
definition: The leading of the Holy Spirit is His work of guiding believers in truth, holiness, wisdom, obedience, and dependence on Christ.
summary: The Spirit leads God's children in ways that agree with Scripture and glorify Christ.
christFocus: Jesus gives the Spirit to guide His people into truth and faithful obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit leads God's people, but His leading is never opposed to Scripture. He guides in truth, holiness, wisdom, love, and mission.

Being led by the Spirit is not the same as following every impulse or emotion. The Spirit's leading must be tested by the Word, the character of Christ, and wise counsel.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people confuse feelings with the Spirit's leading. This doctrine matters because Spirit-led life must remain Word-grounded and Christ-centered.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek the Spirit's leading through Scripture, prayer, humility, wise counsel, and obedience. Do not call something guidance if it contradicts God's Word.
